Polish-pass round 3 #1: Coordinated press cap.

User: "kinda make it football". Options 1-2-3 trilogy shipped ca96e3a/13a3b7b/afedc06. Round 3 starts sim-side football-intelligence improvements while Unity AI does viewer-side polish in parallel.

Context: today BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick press branch fires for EVERY outfield player within PressRadiusMetres of ball. At 25m radius (direct-pressing) often 5-7 swarm. Reads as puck swarm not football. Real football: 2-3 press, others mark space.

acceptance:
- New constant `MaxPressersPerTeam` (int = 3) in BehaviorTreeRunner. Phase-3 fixed; Phase-4 may move per-archetype YAML.
- Press branch refactored: pre-compute list of own-team OUTFIELD (skip GK, slot != 1) players within PressRadius. If <= 3, all press (today's behavior). If > 3, ONLY K=3 nearest press; others fall through to hold-shape (Option-3 ball-translated formation).
- Deterministic K-nearest: ties on distSq resolve by lower roster index (matches NearestPlayerIndex pattern).
- GK has its own branch BEFORE press (Option-2) — no exclusion needed in press code path.
- Q32.32 throughout; no allocation in hot path (stackalloc or fixed array).
- All 5 OffBall + 5 GK + 7 PlayerSeparation tests still pass.
- New tests in MatchSim.Tests/Sim/CoordinatedPressTests.cs (NEW, 5 facts ~200 LoC):
  1. PressOpenContest_FewerThanCap_AllInRangePress
  2. PressOpenContest_OverCap_OnlyTopKPressOthersHoldShape
  3. PressDistanceTiesResolveByLowerIndex
  4. PressGoalkeeperNeverPresses
  5. PressDeterministic_AcrossManyRuns
- All 3 pinned canonical hashes WILL drift (press from tick 0):
  - 60-tick smoke (7e851976...50e) — authorized re-baseline
  - 60-tick primed (815a90e5...7050) — authorized re-baseline
  - 600-tick pass-the-ball (01a32f1e...d98f) — authorized re-baseline
  - Both corpus JSONs (0xdeadbeefdeadbeef + 0xfeedbeefcafefade) re-pin
- fw verify GREEN; scripts/fw replay both seeds rc=0 after re-pin
- Natural-play L2: DotsViewer.unity + usePrimedFixture=true, ≥30s. Watch how many home players within ~5m of ball when away has possession — must be ≤3 (cap). Screenshot docs/screenshots/c7-polish3-coordinated-press-cap-natural-*.png

commit-proposal: Polish-pass round 3 #1 coordinated press cap

## Summary
`BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick` press branch now caps at `MaxPressersPerTeam = 3` simultaneous pressers per team. Pre-loop, `ResolveTopKPressers` walks outfield (slot != 1) candidates within `PressRadiusMetres`, returns indices of the K nearest (ties on distSq break by lower roster index). Press branch fires only for `i in topK`; non-topK in-range players fall through to hold-shape (Option-3 ball-translated formation). GK branch unchanged — fires first per Option-2; never enters press code path.

## Files
- MatchSim/Sim/BehaviorTreeRunner.cs (+~85 LoC: MaxPressersPerTeam const, ResolveTopKPressers helper using stackalloc Span<int>/Span<long>, IndexIsInTopK linear-scan, press-branch refactor)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/CoordinatedPressTests.cs (new, 5 facts, ~240 LoC)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/PassTheBallTests.cs (re-pin 600-tick + 5-entry history)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/LowCutbackPrimedFixtureTests.cs (re-pin smoke local const)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/MatchDeterminismTests.cs (re-pin SmokeSeed60TickHash + history comment)
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json (re-pin)
- unity-project/Assets/Plugins/MatchSim/{dll,pdb} (refreshed)
- docs/screenshots/c7-polish3-coordinated-press-cap-natural-frame{68843,113664}.png

## Tests: 673/673 PASS (+5 new CoordinatedPressTests facts from 668).

## fw verify
GREEN. dotnet test 673/673. banned-terms clean. shader-audit clean. verify-unity-plugins clean.

## Natural-play L2 observation
DotsViewer.unity (driveSim=true, usePrimedFixture=true, seed 0xfeedbeefcafefade). ~35s wall-clock natural play, ZERO synthetic injection.

Frame 88311 snapshot (ball at -39.26, 1.38 — home defensive third):
- HOME outfield within press_radius=25m: **7** (eligible candidates)
- HOME outfield within 10m of ball: **3** (matches K=3 cap exactly)
- AWAY outfield within press_radius=25m: 2 (away pushing forward, only 2 close)

This is the load-bearing evidence: WITHOUT the cap, ALL 7 home outfield in range would sprint at ball → puck swarm. WITH the cap: only 3 nearest press, the other 4 fall through to Option-3 hold-shape and stay in formation-relative-to-ball positions. **Football, not pucks**.

L2 screenshot frame 113664: c7-polish3-coordinated-press-cap-natural-frame113664.png. Shows: home GK + 2-3 home outfield close to ball at left penalty area; remaining home outfield spread in midfield + back/wide positions; away mostly on right half. Compact 3-presser shape visible.

## Scope cleanliness
`git status --short` shows in-scope files staged (BehaviorTreeRunner / tests / corpus / DLL / dialog / screenshots). Unity AI Assistant's parallel viewer work (modified `unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/PitchQuad.cs`, `DotPool.cs`, `DotsMatchDirector.cs`, `ShotCamera.cs`; new `CarrierIndicator.cs` + `PitchMarkings.shader`; ProjectSettings drift) is LEFT UNSTAGED — Unity AI commits those independently. NO collision with their files.

## Acceptance
- [x] MaxPressersPerTeam=3 constant + K-nearest pre-compute + IndexIsInTopK
- [x] Press branch gated by topK membership; non-topK fall through to hold-shape
- [x] Deterministic ties by lower index (PressDistanceTiesResolveByLowerIndex)
- [x] GK never enters press code path (separate branch fires first per Option-2)
- [x] Q32.32; stackalloc; no allocation in hot path
- [x] All PlayerSeparation/GK/OffBall tests still pass (independent surfaces)
- [x] Authorized hash drift re-pinned with history; primed UNCHANGED
- [x] fw verify GREEN; 673/673 tests
- [x] L2 captured + position-validated against K=3 cap

Awaiting reviewer ack.

ACK: I found no blocking issues in the coordinated press cap staged changes. The staged diff keeps the MatchSim change scoped to `BehaviorTreeRunner`, computes top-K outfield pressers with deterministic distance/index ordering, gates the press branch by top-K membership, and leaves the GK branch ahead of press as required. The new tests cover under-cap, over-cap, tie-break, GK exclusion behavior, and determinism; the authorized smoke/pass-the-ball hash pins and smoke corpus fixture were updated consistently.

Verification run locally: `scripts/fw verify` green with 673/673 tests, `scripts/fw replay 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus` exit 0, `scripts/fw replay 0xfeedbeefcafefade --compare-corpus` exit 0, and `git diff --cached --check` clean. I treated the unstaged Unity viewer/ProjectSettings files as parallel out-of-scope work and reviewed only the staged commit-proposal surface.
